title: Sanna in the Sky

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Welcome to the sky. It's nice to see a friendly face. Or at least a face without a wrinkled nose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Welcome to the sky. It's nice to see a friendly face. Or at least a face without a wrinkled nose.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Trying to fit in... and failing. I feel about as welcome here as an implant aneurism. It's amazing how you can climb so high, but still get looked down on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trying to fit in... and failing. I feel about as welcome here as an implant aneurism. It's amazing how you can climb so high, but still get looked down on.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Maybe not for you. Some of these people know what I do. Do you know what they call me? An "omen". I'm bad news, but in human form.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe not for you. Some of these people know what I do. Do you know what they call me? An "omen". I'm bad news, but in human form.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Maybe I SHOULD quit. All I do is read reports about potential disasters, then I go to those disaster areas and report on whether commerce will be affected. Oh, and I have to encourage everyone to keep doing business as usual.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I SHOULD quit. All I do is read reports about potential disasters, then I go to those disaster areas and report on whether commerce will be affected. Oh, and I have to encourage everyone to keep doing business as usual.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I read reports about potential disasters, then I go to those disaster areas and report on whether commerce will be affected. Oh, and I have to encourage everyone to keep doing business as usual.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I read reports about potential disasters, then I go to those disaster areas and report on whether commerce will be affected. Oh, and I have to encourage everyone to keep doing business as usual.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: It's not. Everyone groans when they see me. The worst part is, they're not frightened. Not surprised. Just... resigned. When did Nivalis get so... hopeless?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not. Everyone groans when they see me. The worst part is, they're not frightened. Not surprised. Just... resigned. When did Nivalis get so... hopeless?

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I'm not in the mood for being a harbinger of doom. I think I might need to change career again. Something more hopeful, like pushing a fucking boulder up a hill for eternity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not in the mood for being a harbinger of doom. I think I might need to change career again. Something more hopeful, like pushing a fucking boulder up a hill for eternity.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: I don't want anything from you. Or anyone. No offense, but working at all right now is not helping me. I might just sell some organs for cash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want anything from you. Or anyone. No offense, but working at all right now is not helping me. I might just sell some organs for cash.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Sure. I can get budget replacements. A healthy organic heart is worth more than one of those basic Haemo-Pump 300's.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. I can get budget replacements. A healthy organic heart is worth more than one of those basic Haemo-Pump 300's.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: You know, I think after a break up, everyone does the same three things. Man or woman, android or Automata. We all do the same fucking things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, I think after a break up, everyone does the same three things. Man or woman, android or Automata. We all do the same fucking things.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Change our hair, try to keep the five best mutual friends on our side, and order that one dish we loved, but our ex hated. Marina hated the way my favorite food smelled.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Change our hair, try to keep the five best mutual friends on our side, and order that one dish we loved, but our ex hated. Marina hated the way my favorite food smelled.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Kimchi. But you know what... when I finally ordered some, I couldn't stand the smell either. It smelled like...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kimchi. But you know what... when I finally ordered some, I couldn't stand the smell either. It smelled like...

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: It smelled like it was going into me, then leaking out of me, and no one wants to be near me. I reek.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It smelled like it was going into me, then leaking out of me, and no one wants to be near me. I reek.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: Metaphorically. Look, I'm gonna go. No one needs another depression session, especially not here. I mean, look at this place! Pretty impressive. These rich folks sure know how to make you feel small.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Metaphorically. Look, I'm gonna go. No one needs another depression session, especially not here. I mean, look at this place! Pretty impressive. These rich folks sure know how to make you feel small.

nodes.speaker: Sanna Sinamon
nodes.text: See you around. Maybe on the Rig? I hear there's work there... and seclusion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See you around. Maybe on the Rig? I hear there's work there... and seclusion.
What are you doing here?
Are you ok?
It's not THAT bad.
Maybe you should quit.
What's your job again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That doesn't sound like a great job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That doesn't sound like a great job.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That doesn't sound like a great job.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That doesn't sound like a great job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Things are getting worse.
It's always been like this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you still want to work for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you still want to work for me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you still want to work for me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you still want to work for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't really help you.
You can do that?
Good business sense!
That seems drastic.
What three things?
Which dish?
Garlic?
Chilli?
Loneliness?
I can't smell it.
Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not small, Sanna. Hope to see you soon!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not small, Sanna. Hope to see you soon!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're not small, Sanna. Hope to see you soon!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're not small, Sanna. Hope to see you soon!
